chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Abdullah al-Barqi, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sulayman, from Abu Ayyub al-Madani, from Sulayman ibn Ja'far al-Ja'fari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
In each wing of the hoopoe is inscribed in Syriac: 'The Progeny of Muhammad are the best of the creation.'
ai.seo_question: What is inscribed on the wings of the hoopoe bird according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) narrates that the phrase 'The Progeny of Muhammad are the best of creation' is inscribed on the wings of the hoopoe in Syriac, a tradition often cited to highlight the cosmic significance and preeminence of the Ahl al-Bayt. This narration, found in *Al-Kafi*, underscores the divine selection of the Imams, linking their spiritual authority to the natural world as recorded in the language of the Gospels.
